snippet.title: Oprost - Teaser Trailer | September 2025
snippet.description:
Wishlist here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3013420/Oprost/

Venture into a magical yet destroyed forest full of a variety of creatures.
40 days after losing his wife, Arik is facing a monster that is threatening to destroy the forest and everything in it. On your journey you will find creatures who will give you their powers in order to move through the chaos and face the monster of thorns and weeds. Oprost is a story about loss and farewell told through a 2D precision platformer.
